# Bucksworth Home Services

> Family-owned Arizona pest control, termite, and weed & lawn care company serving 35 cities across the Phoenix and Tucson metro areas since 2013. We also offer air conditioning, heating, plumbing, and water heater service in the Phoenix metro. AZ ROC #343924. AZ Department of Agriculture License #9613. Google Guaranteed.

Bucksworth Home Services is a residential home services company founded in 2013 by Jordan and Taylor Moore. Our primary services are Pest & Termite control and Weed & Lawn Care, offered in all 35 cities we serve. Air Conditioning & Heating and Plumbing & Water Heaters are offered in our 26 Phoenix-metro cities only.

- Phoenix branch phone: (480) 422-8388
- Tucson branch phone: (520) 284-9930
- Website: https://www.getyourbucksworth.com
- Headquarters: 2073 W Houston Ave Suite 101, Apache Junction, AZ 85120
- Tucson Office: 3430 E Sunrise Dr Suite 180, Tucson, AZ 85718
- Licenses: AZ ROC #343924, AZ Department of Agriculture License #9613
- Founded: 2013
- Service area: 35 cities (26 Phoenix metro, 9 Tucson metro)
- Request service online: https://www.getyourbucksworth.com/request-service

## Primary Services

- [Pest & Termite](https://www.getyourbucksworth.com/phoenix-az/pest-and-termite): Scorpions, termites, roaches, ants, spiders, rodents, bed bugs, mosquitoes, bees and wasps. All 35 cities.
- [Weed & Lawn Care](https://www.getyourbucksworth.com/phoenix-az/weed-and-lawn-care): Pre-emergent and post-emergent weed control, gravel and rock yard care, Bermuda grass control, lawn fertilization, overseeding. All 35 cities.

## Other Services (Phoenix metro only)

- [Air Conditioning & Heating](https://www.getyourbucksworth.com/phoenix-az/air-conditioning-and-heating): AC repair, installation and maintenance, heating, ductwork, insulation.
- [Plumbing & Water Heaters](https://www.getyourbucksworth.com/phoenix-az/plumbing-and-water-heaters): Water heaters, leak detection, drain cleaning, sewer lines, water treatment.
